review.decision: Fix only confirmed PR1876 independent P2 before adding its regression
review.notes: Full original60ee9 relay/report and all manifest items read and SHA verified. Original Hf066 and reviewer fixture/red log remain immutable. Use synchronous refs plus render state for the complete native photo-read lifecycle, guard captured button/Return callbacks and reentry, and clear only sent attachment IDs as defensive preservation. Preserve one-photo editor-first, batch order, cancel/error/unmount handling, five-argument uploads and existing assertions. New tests only in the listed file, no old fixture edits. cases.description: A photo read in flight excludes Send, Return and captured callbacks until the full batch stages
cases.setup: Production Composer and original AttachSheet, existing two photos/caption; deferred second native picker result after dismissal; captured send/Return and picker callbacks
cases.action: Start second selection, invoke live/captured Send and Return, attempt another selection, then complete later photos and explicitly Send
cases.expected: No upload/send/history or clearing while read is pending; visible disabled Send and concise reading feedback. Only one picker request; all four photos remain ordered and a later explicit Send uploads each exactly once before the original caption/paths are submitted. No automatic resend.

cases.description: Cancel, native error or throw releases the selection guard without losing draft or staged attachments
cases.setup: Same production Composer with existing photos/caption and controlled cancelled/error/rejected selection
cases.action: Keep selection pending then settle each failure kind; choose again or explicitly Send
cases.expected: Full lifecycle finally releases ref/state, pending selection blocks send and reentry; after settlement a new selection/send is possible. Caption and existing images remain; no automatic upload/send, no spurious photo editor. Existing unmount late-result guard remains.

cases.description: Successful upload clears only attachments from its captured send snapshot
cases.setup: Existing staged photos and a deferred previously opened File picker, plus controlled sequential uploads
cases.action: Begin sending the existing photos, let a new file arrive during those uploads, then complete the original send
cases.expected: Message contains only that send snapshot in order; later file remains staged for its own explicit Send. No asset deletion or silent removal of unsent IDs. Existing upload failure preservation stays unchanged.
